name: immunopeptidomics-deep-rescoring-workflow
description: Use when MGF immunopeptidomics spectra must be searched without enzyme specificity, augmented with run-specific retention-time and predicted-spectrum features, rescored, and controlled at both PSM and peptide false-discovery levels.

name: isobaric-reporter-quantification-workflow
description: Use when TMT, TMTpro, or iTRAQ mzML runs must be searched, quantified at the reporter-ion level, filtered for co-isolation interference, aggregated to proteins, and tested for condition-level abundance changes.
